name: Ghanacard Personal Identification Number (Ghanacard PIN)
note: Ghana's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: since 1 April 2021 the Ghanacard PIN the National Identification Authority issues is the tax number of individuals eligible for the Ghanacard, and a permanent resident's non-citizen card serves too; it is three parts joined by hyphens, a 3-letter ISO country code of the holder's nationality at first registration, an 8- or 9-digit system number and a checksum character (used internally), 15 with hyphens, 13 without; the pattern draws the 9-digit form. Read as given on application (registration with the NIA). The checksum's rule isn't published, so `check` is left out. No age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Ghana: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: From 1st April, 2021 the 15- character Ghanacard Personal Identification Number, (Ghanacard PIN) ... issued by the National Identification Authority (NIA), became the TIN for individuals who are eligible ... The Non-citizen card of foreign individuals permanently resident in Ghana also ... there are 3 parts : Country Code, 8 or 9 digit number, checksum character.
